subject: Create type definitions (src/engine/types.ts)
description:
Create `src/engine/types.ts` with all shared type definitions from the plan:
- `Scenario` interface (timestampLocal: Date, hour, isDay, optional weather/sun fields)
- `SerializedScenario` interface (JSON-safe version with ISO string dates)
- `AspectRatio` type union
- `GeminiConfig` interface (model, optional aspectRatio, imageSize, seed)
- `PromptConfig` interface (template, extraContext)
- `RenderMetadata` interface (id, artworkSource, scenario as SerializedScenario, prompt, model, createdAt, outputPath, responseText, seed, observability fields)
- `GenerateResult` interface (metadata, imagePath, imageBuffer)
- `PipelineConfig` interface (outputDir, maxOutputs, geminiConfig, promptConfig)
- `serializeScenario()` function

This is the foundation — all other modules depend on these types.
